data.summary: The validation run processed 1,000 rows with splits train 604, test 199, oot 197. Detectors fired 1, and the challenger achieved 0.607 versus champion 0.998. A high‑severity finding (F‑02) indicates the challenger was trained and assessed on the same rows, raising a data‑leakage risk.
reasons: High‑severity finding F‑02 indicates data leakage risk
Challenger trained and assessed on same rows undermines model validity
Other findings (F‑01, F‑03) raise concerns about bias and feature usage
